_comment: RAD-96 (M2-08, RC-069): mutation testing on the money, GST and (with M2-03) posting functions, and the stock engine's valuation (M2-05). A surviving mutant is a change to the maths no test noticed. The score must stay at or above 80%.
_comment_tz: Stryker runs vitest in worker threads, which share their process's time zone, so lib-common's test.env TZ can't reach them, and Node on Windows ignores a TZ given at launch. Each test-runner process sets it first instead, so the suite runs outside India as it does under vitest (RC-204).
